name: How long does it typically take to install a new picture window?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a new picture window?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for a new picture window generally ranges from a few hours to a full day per window, depending on the opening's existing condition and any necessary structural modifications. Complex installations, such as enlarging an existing opening or creating a new one, will naturally take longer. Hometelligent will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project in areas like Emeryville or Albany.
acceptedAnswer.description: Picture window installation typically takes a few hours to a full day. Complex projects requiring structural changes may take longer.
